evidence: Actual Blender renders and Unity Camera.main renders; no AI concept substitution

findings.upperBody: The previous detached oversized chest/shoulder plates were replaced by anatomy-following continuous cloth. Side and 45-degree silhouettes no longer show those plate protrusions.
findings.shoulder: Raised-arm render shows connected shoulder/underarm/sleeve fabric without the previous open gap or skin patch.
findings.bodice: Overlapping black/white surfaces that produced poke-through were removed. Sewn colour regions share the fitted surface.
findings.face: Cheek, jaw, orbital and nose/lip volume changed through Basis vertices with matching expression and LOD edits; identity and gold eyes remain.
findings.hair: Blonde wave tails and black bows remain. Fringe end and tail end shaping was edited with roots retained.
findings.lods: Discovered jagged skirt hem in forced LOD views was repaired; final Unity forced LOD captures have continuous hems.
findings.unity: Imported face, hair, costume and identity remain recognisable in the actual game, action camera and three-character comparison. No severe cloth break or blocking obstruction was observed in the reviewed poses/captures.

limitations: Blender and Unity use different real lighting and Idle evaluation; cross-engine boards are not same-light comparisons.
Far LODs simplify small fabric, collar, pleat and hair details.
Android device FPS was not measured.
productionVerification: OK for the recorded model, poses and game checks
